request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, flute, solemn and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They rounded up the scoundrels
From the marketplace street
Formed a wild and angry mob
In the city's heat
They stormed the house at night
To find the two men
But they could not find them there
So the search was done

[Verse]
They dragged Jason to the court
Along with some brothers
Shouting out their accusation
With their loud reports
These men turned the world upside down
Now they have come here
Jason has taken them in
The anger is clear

[Verse]
They act against the decrees
Of Caesar the great
Saying there is another king
With a different fate
The crowd was thrown into confusion
The officials confused
But Jason stood his ground
In this dangerous news

[Verse]
So they took bail from Jason
And the others too
And released them from the court
As the day broke through
The cost was paid for the gospel
The loss was his share
Yet he welcomed them freely
With his open door

[Outro]
Jason sends his greetings
A kinsman of Paul
